# FCC bans, Section 232 floors, and a $10bn Tesla bet

Author: Solarplaza

What US solar's new trade regime means before the 4 December deadline [...] On 6 August 2026, a separate Section 232 proclamation established a minimum import price (MIP) program across the solar value chain: $21/kg on polysilicon, $100/kg on ingots and wafers, $0.22/W on cells, and $0.38/W on modules. An additional 15% ad valorem tariff applies on top of the MIP for ingots, wafers, cells, and modules, though not for raw polysilicon (Shanghai Metals Market).
